title: geographical convergent cross mapping — gccm
text: cause causal series (character vector). effect effect series (character vector). nb (optional) neighbours list. coords (optional) coordinates matrix. data (optional) observation data. libsizes (optional) vector library sizes use. E (optional) dimensions embedding. trend_rm (optional) Variables need remove linear trends. ... (optional) parameters passed sdsfun::spdep_nb().
